sessSdk.name: @sess.si/sdk
sessSdk.source: scripts/sdk-pin.mjs pack: npm pack of the repository root, accepted only if the bytes equal release/sdk-candidate.json
sessSdk.releaseHold: Before publishing @sess.si/mcp, the pinned @sess.si/sdk version must be genuinely published with the pinned bytes. Then `npm run sdk:switch-to-registry -- --apply` switches package-lock.json to the registry tarball, accepted only with the pinned integrity and SHA-256, and the lockfile change is reviewed. The digest-gated .candidate mechanism is retained for development; the release workflow refuses candidate mode.
